$comment: Machine-readable record of the four OCI Printer Application version forms.
The grammar (the regex) and published_tags are observed/inferred from each
printer-app repo's stable branch (VERSION file, existing release tags); only
the version_source and tag-equality enforcement are transcribed from the
inferred from existing tags (10.07.1-1, 10.07.1-2): the publish workflow
verifies the tag equals v$VERSION and points at a stable commit, but it
does not validate the version shape itself. Narrative and evidence:
This file records observed/agreed semantics; it is not itself a policy change.

families.rebuild_slot_note: The trailing number is the packaging revision; there is no separate rebuild counter, so an FSDK-only rebuild bumps the same field. Only Gutenprint carries a distinct rebuild counter (its optional .N suffix).
families.version_source: VERSION (single line, the only version source)
families.enforcement: registry-actions.yml metadata step: release tag must equal v$VERSION and point at a commit on stable; image labels org.opencontainers.image.version are checked against $VERSION after push; re-pushing an existing tag is refused. The grammar below is inferred from existing tags (10.07.1-1, 10.07.1-2); the workflow does not validate the version shape itself.

families.upstream_source: HPLIP upstream release, taken from the Debian source tag (e.g. 3.26.4+dfsg0-3)
families.rebuild_slot_note: VERSION is pinned to the upstream version by regex, so an FSDK-only rebuild has no distinct immutable version: the tag is already published and the workflow refuses to overwrite it.
families.version_source: VERSION, cross-checked against the '# source-tag:' comment in elements/printer-app/hplip.bst
families.enforcement: registry-actions.yml metadata step: VERSION must equal the version component of the debian/<upstream>+dfsg0-<n> source tag, the tag must be v$VERSION at stable HEAD, and the tag must not already exist in GHCR.

families.upstream_source: Gutenprint upstream release plus its Debian revision (e.g. 5.3.6-4)
families.rebuild_slot_note: The optional .N suffix is documented in the repo's own workflow as marking an OCI-only rebuild of the same Debian revision, because immutable registry tags can never be republished.
families.version_source: include/source-pins.yml (gutenprint-version, cross-checked against gutenprint-tag and gutenprint-ref)
families.enforcement: registry-actions.yml metadata step: version must match the grammar, its <upstream>-<packaging> part must equal the Debian tag's version, the Debian tag ref must equal the pinned ref, the release tag must be v$version, and the tag must not already exist in GHCR.

families.upstream_source: foomatic-db snapshot date stamped into the image (e.g. 20240504)
families.rebuild_slot_note: The trailing number is the packaging revision; there is no separate rebuild counter, so an FSDK-only rebuild bumps the same field.
families.version_source: VERSION, staged by elements/printer-app/version.bst and read into the image version label by elements/oci/ps-printer-app.bst
families.enforcement: registry-actions.yml metadata step: VERSION must match the grammar, the tag must be v$VERSION at the stable HEAD commit, and the tag must not already exist in GHCR.
families.published_tags_note: No v* tag and no GHCR image: publication is held on ps-printer-app#27 (upstream security review). The hold is on release only, not on the version form recorded here.
